about.story.p1: Veidne is a family project. We're a husband and wife team who got tired of the complicated, expensive tools needed to generate personalized documents.
about.story.p2: We searched for solutions, but found only complexity. Mail merge plugins that break. Enterprise software with 100-page manuals. Online tools that upload your sensitive data to unknown servers.
about.story.p3: So we built what we wished existed. Veidne is simple: upload a template, connect your data, download your documents. That's it.
about.story.p4bold: Your templates and spreadsheets never leave your device.
about.story.p4end: We don't store your files, because your templates and spreadsheets are never sent to us. Apart from the technical logs every web server keeps, the only information our server collects automatically is first-party usage statistics: which pages you open, which features you use and the site or campaign that brought you here. Only if you allow it are they tied to a cookie that tells browsers apart; we never link them to a name, an email address or a donation, and they never include your file names, contents or data. Anything else we keep, a donation, a suggestion or a bug report, is something you chose to send us yourself. No third-party scripts, fonts or trackers are loaded.
about.story.pdf: One exception, by design: creating PDFs. Your documents are merged in your browser as always, and if you choose PDF, the finished files are sent to Veidne's own server to be converted, then deleted the moment your download is ready. They are never stored and never shared with anyone. If you skip PDF, your documents and data never leave your device.
about.story.openSourceStart: You do not have to take this on trust. Everything that runs in your browser, which is the part that touches your files, is open source under AGPL-3.0 at
about.story.openSourceEnd: . You or your IT department can read it and see for yourselves that your templates and spreadsheets are never uploaded. The PDF conversion service is the one piece that is not open, which is why we described exactly what it does above.
about.story.p5: Veidne is free and sustained entirely by our community. If it saves you time, consider supporting us so we can keep improving it.
about.founders.message: We hope Veidne makes your work a little easier.
about.costs.heading: What Veidne costs to run
about.costs.p1: Veidne runs on two servers in Germany. Together they cost about 20 euros a month, plus a domain name once a year.
about.costs.p2: There is no paid tier, no ads and no third-party trackers. The only analytics are our own first-party usage statistics, which never include your files or data. Veidne is built by two people in Riga and funded by donations.

landing.faq.heading: Questions before you start
landing.faq.q1: Will my dates, amounts and leading zeros come out right?
landing.faq.a1: Yes. Leading zeros, currency symbols and date formats come through from Excel. Where Excel uses your computer's own style, such as 14.11.2026 or 1 234,50, you pick that style when you match your columns. Month and day names come out in English.
landing.faq.q2: Does it work on a Chromebook or a work computer?
landing.faq.a2: Veidne runs in the browser and installs nothing. If your document is in Google Docs, download it as Microsoft Word (.docx) first.
landing.faq.q3: What if a column does not match a field?
landing.faq.a3: You match it by hand in the data step, and the preview shows the result before you download.
landing.faq.a4: Yes. Veidne is funded by donations; hosting costs about 20 euros a month.
landing.hero.noDocOr: or try it with sample data above.
landing.faq.q5: I don't have a spreadsheet yet.
landing.faq.a5: Mark the fields in your document first. Veidne then gives you a spreadsheet with a column for each field, ready to fill in.

privacyNotice.files.heading: Your Word document and Excel list stay on your device
privacyNotice.files.p1: When you open a Word document and an Excel list, Veidne reads and merges them in your browser. They are not uploaded to Veidne or to anyone else, and neither are the documents you generate, unless you choose PDF.
privacyNotice.files.p2: The part of Veidne that runs in your browser is open source, so you or your IT department can check this:
privacyNotice.files.p3: So that you can continue after closing the tab, your browser keeps your unfinished project on this device: a copy of your Word document if it is under about 3 MB, otherwise only its text as shown in the editor, its file name and the fields you marked. Your Excel list is never kept. The project is removed when you finish a run or start over.
privacyNotice.pdf.heading: PDF conversion, only if you choose it
privacyNotice.pdf.p1: Creating PDFs is the one step that needs a server. Before anything is sent, Veidne asks you to confirm, and you can keep the Word files instead.
privacyNotice.pdf.p2: If you confirm, the documents you generated and their file names are sent over an encrypted connection to Veidne's conversion server, convert.veidne.com. File names are built from your list, so they can contain personal data such as a person's name.
privacyNotice.pdf.p3: The server is in Nuremberg, Germany, and is hosted for us by Hetzner Online GmbH. It uses your documents only to convert them and deletes them when your download is ready. Like any web server, it receives your IP address with the request and may record technical details of each request in its logs, which are used only to keep the service running and secure.
privacyNotice.pdf.p4: Legal basis: providing the conversion you ask for (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR).
privacyNotice.pdf.p5: The conversion server does not receive the veidne_uid cookie described below.
privacyNotice.cookies.heading: Usage statistics and cookies
privacyNotice.cookies.p1: Veidne counts how it is used, so we can see what works and what to fix. There are no analytics, advertising or tracking scripts from other companies.
privacyNotice.cookies.p2: Only if you allow it, our server sets one cookie on veidne.com, named veidne_uid. It holds a random identifier that tells your browser apart from others in the statistics. It is never linked to a name, to the email address in a bug report, to a suggestion or to a donation, and our server stores it only in a scrambled form (a salted hash).
privacyNotice.cookies.purpose: Tells browsers apart in the usage statistics. Only with your consent
privacyNotice.cookies.cfSetBy: Cloudflare, which may set them to tell people from automated traffic
privacyNotice.cookies.cfPurpose: Security. Strictly necessary, so no consent is asked
privacyNotice.cookies.voterSetBy: Veidne's server, only when you vote on the roadmap
privacyNotice.cookies.voterPurpose: Remembers your votes, so you can see them and take them back. Needed for the vote you asked for, so no consent is asked. After 25 months a vote stays counted but can no longer be connected to your browser
privacyNotice.cookies.p3: Without your consent, no statistics cookie is set and the statistics are recorded without any identifier, so they cannot be connected to each other or to you. Making documents works the same either way.
privacyNotice.cookies.li1: the address of each page you open, without anything after a question mark;
privacyNotice.cookies.li2: for the page you arrive on, the website that sent you (its name only, such as google.com) and any campaign tags in the link (utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign). With your consent your browser keeps these and sends them once, with your first page view;
privacyNotice.cookies.li3: which features you use, such as opening a document, adding a list, generating documents, choosing a template, creating PDFs, answering the feedback question, starting a donation or making your cookie choice, with counts and short labels;
privacyNotice.cookies.li4: the time of each of these events.
privacyNotice.cookies.never: They never include file names, file contents, field names, column names or the values in your list.
privacyNotice.cookies.logs: Like every website, our server also receives your IP address and your browser's name and version with each request. The web server records these in technical logs, used only to keep Veidne running and secure. The logs are limited in size, so the oldest entries are deleted automatically as new ones are written. Legal basis: our legitimate interest in running a secure service (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR).
privacyNotice.cookies.basis: Legal basis: your consent for the cookie and for the statistics tied to it (Article 6(1)(a) GDPR), which is also what the rules on storing information on your device require. For the statistics without an identifier, our legitimate interest in finding out what to improve (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR). We keep the statistics for 25 months and then delete them. Only the total number of documents made with Veidne, a single number with nothing about who made them, is kept for good.
privacyNotice.cookies.refuse: You can change your choice at any time here, or by clearing this site's data in your browser. Withdrawing your consent removes the cookie the next time Veidne contacts our server, and does not affect what was recorded before.
privacyNotice.cookies.choiceGranted: On this device you allow the statistics cookie.
privacyNotice.cookies.choiceDenied: On this device you do not allow the statistics cookie.
privacyNotice.cookies.choiceNone: You have not made a choice on this device yet.
privacyNotice.storage.heading: What your browser keeps on this device
privacyNotice.storage.p1: Veidne also keeps a few values in your browser's local storage on this device. Most are needed for what you ask Veidne to do, such as keeping your unfinished project or your settings. The one marked "only with your consent" is kept only if you allow statistics. Only veidne_first_touch is ever sent to us, once. Clearing this site's data in your browser deletes all of them.
privacyNotice.storage.firstTouch: Where your first visit came from: the referring website's name and campaign tags, if any. Only with your consent. Sent once, with your first page view.
privacyNotice.storage.session: Your unfinished project: a copy of the Word document if it is under about 3 MB, otherwise only its text as shown in the editor, its file name, the fields you marked and the step you were on. Never sent.
privacyNotice.storage.formatConventions: How dates and numbers look in your documents, such as 14.11.2026 and 1 234,50, if you changed it, so your next spreadsheet gets the same style. Never sent.
privacyNotice.storage.pdfConsent: That you chose "Don't ask again on this device" before creating PDFs. Never sent.
privacyNotice.storage.nudge: That you have made your first field or closed the first hint in the field step, so the hint is not shown again. Never sent.
privacyNotice.storage.rangeHint: That you have selected several words at once, so that hint is not shown again. Never sent.
privacyNotice.storage.donatedAt: When a donation from this browser was confirmed, so Veidne thanks you instead of asking for 180 days. Never sent.
privacyNotice.storage.declinedAt: When you chose "No thanks" in the donation window, so it stays away for 30 days. Never sent.
privacyNotice.storage.donateFrom: That you opened the payment page in a new tab from the results screen, so for one hour the thank-you page can say your documents are still open in the other tab. Never sent.
privacyNotice.storage.consent: Your cookie choice and when you made it, so you are not asked again. Never sent; your choice itself is recorded in the statistics without an identifier.
privacyNotice.storage.untilCleared: Until you clear this site's data
privacyNotice.storage.sessionKept: Until you finish a run, start over or clear this site's data
privacyNotice.storage.consentKept: 12 months, then you are asked again
privacyNotice.storage.withConsent: Until you clear this site's data or withdraw your consent
privacyNotice.storage.p2: The part of Veidne that runs in your browser sets no cookies itself and stores nothing else on your device. Our server sets no cookie other than veidne_uid and, only if you vote on the roadmap, veidne_voter.
privacyNotice.messages.heading: Messages, reports and payments you send
privacyNotice.messages.bug.heading: Bug reports
privacyNotice.messages.bug.p1: The Report a bug form sends us the subject and description you type, your email address if you add one, and a screenshot if you attach one (PNG or JPG, up to 5 MB). A screenshot can show your document, so crop it or leave it out if it shows personal data.
privacyNotice.messages.bug.p2: We use reports to find and fix problems and, if you gave an email address, to reply to you. Reports are not stored on our server: they reach us as emails through our email provider, and we delete them, with any email address and screenshot, within 12 months. Legal basis: our legitimate interest in fixing Veidne and answering you (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR).
privacyNotice.messages.suggest.heading: Suggestions after a donation
privacyNotice.messages.suggest.p1: After a completed donation, the thank-you page lets you send a suggestion. It is sent together with the reference of your payment, so it is linked to your donation.
privacyNotice.messages.suggest.p2: We store the title and text of your suggestion, the reference of the payment it came with, its status on our roadmap and when it was sent, for 3 years. Legal basis: our legitimate interest in planning Veidne with the people who support it (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR).
privacyNotice.messages.donate.heading: Donations
privacyNotice.messages.donate.p1: When you choose an amount and continue, your browser sends the amount and the currency to our server, which creates a payment page at Stripe, and you are taken there. You enter your payment details on Stripe's page. Veidne loads no Stripe script and never receives your card details.
privacyNotice.messages.donate.p2: When you come back, the thank-you page asks our server for the amount and whether the payment went through.
privacyNotice.messages.donate.p3: Stripe processes your payment as an independent controller under its own privacy policy, stripe.com/privacy; in the EU this is Stripe Payments Europe, Limited, in Ireland. Veidne stores only the reference of the payment, the amount, the currency and whether the payment went through, never your name, email address or card details. We keep these records for 5 years, because accounting law requires it (Article 6(1)(c) GDPR).
privacyNotice.messages.email.heading: Email
privacyNotice.messages.email.p1: Some screens offer a link to write to info@veidne.com. If you write to us, we receive your email address and your message.
privacyNotice.messages.email.p2: We keep emails as long as we need them to answer you, and delete them within 12 months of the last message. Legal basis: our legitimate interest in answering you (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR).
privacyNotice.messages.links.heading: Links to other websites
privacyNotice.messages.links.p1: Links to Trustpilot, where you can review Veidne, and to GitHub, where the source code is, open those websites in a new tab under their own privacy policies. Veidne does not tell them which page you came from. When you click a Trustpilot link, the usage statistics record that click.
privacyNotice.recipients.heading: Who else handles data
privacyNotice.recipients.p1: Veidne's own code loads no scripts, fonts or trackers from other companies.
privacyNotice.recipients.p2: Veidne does not sell personal data or use it for advertising. These companies process data for us, as our processors: Hetzner Online GmbH hosts our web, API and conversion servers in Nuremberg, Germany; Cloudflare, Inc. sits in front of veidne.com, passes every request on to our server and protects it from attacks, so it processes your IP address and the request; Namecheap, Inc. provides our email, including bug reports. Stripe handles payments as described above. Cloudflare and Namecheap are based in the United States: transfers to them rely on the EU standard contractual clauses and, for Cloudflare, also on its certification under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework.
privacyNotice.rights.heading: Your rights
privacyNotice.rights.p1: You can ask us for a copy of the personal data we hold about you, and ask us to correct or delete it. You can also object to how we use it, ask us to limit its use, or ask for it in a portable format. Where we rely on your consent, you can withdraw it at any time. Write to {email}.
privacyNotice.rights.p2: Veidne has no accounts. Statistics can be connected to your browser only if you allowed the cookie and send us its value, which you can see in your browser's site settings or developer tools under veidne_uid. Once you withdraw your consent, the cookie is removed and the records can no longer be connected to you. You do not have to give us any personal data to use Veidne, and we make no decisions about you by automated means.
privacyNotice.rights.p3: You can also complain to the Data State Inspectorate of Latvia (Datu valsts inspekcija), www.dvi.gov.lv, or to the data protection authority where you live or work.
privacyNotice.changes.heading: Changes to this notice
privacyNotice.changes.p1: When this notice changes, we change the date at the top.
accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.lead: Everyone should be able to make their documents with Veidne. Our target is WCAG 2.2 at level AA for the whole site, including the editor. We are not there yet, and this page lists what is still missing.
accessibility.target.heading: What we aim for
accessibility.target.p1: We build Veidne to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2, level AA. There has been no independent audit yet. Automated tests check the contrast of small text and that fields can be marked in a document with the keyboard alone.
accessibility.target.p2: Every page starts with a Skip to content link, and decorative animations stop when your device is set to reduce motion.
accessibility.gaps.heading: Known problems
accessibility.gaps.intro: These parts do not meet the target yet. We remove each one from this list when it is fixed.
accessibility.gaps.gap1: In the editor, screen readers hear the words of your document as plain text, without being told which words are selected. A short message announces each selection and each new field instead (WCAG 4.1.2).
accessibility.gaps.gap2: On phones, a few text links in the editor are less than 24 pixels high (WCAG 2.5.8).
accessibility.gaps.gap3: On wide screens the background of the home page moves slowly and cannot be paused. It stops when your device is set to reduce motion (WCAG 2.2.2).
accessibility.contact.heading: Tell us about a problem
accessibility.contact.p1: If something on Veidne is hard or impossible for you to use, write to {email} or use Report a bug at the top of any page (under Menu on phones). Tell us the page, what you tried, and the browser or assistive technology you use.
accessibility.contact.p2: We read every message and reply when we can. Veidne is free, so we cannot promise a reply time, but what you tell us decides what we fix next.
import.title: Fields found in your template
import.title.controls: This template was made for another mail merge tool
import.intro: Veidne found placeholders from another mail merge tool. Choose the ones that should become Veidne fields. Your document is not changed until you confirm.
import.list.label: Placeholders found
import.row.lowConfidence: Often ordinary text. Tick it only if this is a field.
import.formats: In Word, {names} had date or number formatting. Veidne inserts the spreadsheet value exactly as it is, so these can look different from Word's output. Format those cells in the spreadsheet the way they should appear.
import.outsideBody: Fields in headers and footers are filled too. The editor shows the page text only, so they are listed under Fields as "in header/footer".
import.controls.title: Part of this template cannot work in Veidne
import.controls.what: It contains instructions from another mail merge tool: {tags}.
import.controls.why: Veidne makes one document per spreadsheet row. It cannot repeat content inside one document, such as the lines of an invoice, and it cannot choose text with a condition.
import.controls.fix: Remove these instructions in Word, together with the content they repeat or choose, and upload the file again. Until then Veidne will not generate documents from this template.
import.controls.fieldsStill: You can still add the fields below now.
import.loop.title: The whole document is one repeating section
import.loop.whole: Everything in this document is inside one repeating section, from {open} to {close}. Repeating the whole document once per row is exactly what Veidne does.
import.loop.offer: Veidne can delete just these two tags and keep everything between them, including the fields inside. Nothing else in your document changes.
import.loop.removed: Removed {open} and {close}. Everything that was between them is still in your document, and Veidne makes one copy of it per spreadsheet row.
controls.notice: This template still contains {tags} from another mail merge tool. Veidne makes one document per spreadsheet row and cannot repeat content inside one document or choose text with a condition, so it will not generate documents from it. Remove these in Word and upload the file again.
error.generate.cause.controls: This template contains a repeating section or a condition from another mail merge tool. Veidne makes one document per spreadsheet row and cannot repeat content inside one document. Remove it in Word, then upload the file again.
